line_of_business: Medicare Advantage and Kentucky Medicaid Products

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: According to the American Medical Association (AMA), "Under certain circumstances, a service or procedure is partially reduced or eliminated at the discretion of the physician or other qualified health care professional. Under these circumstances, the service provided can be identified by its usual procedure number and the addition of modifier 52, signifying that the service is reduced. This provides a means of reporting reduced services without disturbing the identification of the basic service." This policy outlines Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for services reported with modifier 52.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Modifier 52 should be used if the procedure is partially reduced, or if the procedure is discontinued either before anesthesia is administered or if anesthesia is not planned. Humana plans allow 50 percent of the contracted rate or the base maximum amount payable under the member's plan when modifier 52 is appropriately appended to a procedure code. In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply. Modifier 52 is not an appropriate modifier for an evaluation and management (E/M) code or a laboratory panel code. Therefore, an E/M or a laboratory panel code is denied if billed with modifier 52.
